verdict.line: You lose if you open Riposte before baiting his Decisive Strike; you win if you poke behind Lunge's 600 range and punish every Q cooldown.

brief.thesis: Garen's entire kill threat runs through Q (Decisive Strike, 8s cooldown, range 300) — it's his only gap closer and it silences you, which is the one tool that can stop your Riposte parry. Everything else he has is short-range (Judgment at 325, Courage's self-area damage), while your Lunge hits from 600, so as long as you track that one cooldown you dictate every trade. That structural gap is why Fiora sits at 56.5% over 138 games here versus a 51.5% baseline.

theirWindow.what: Assume he can dash in and silence you on contact. Don't open with W (Riposte) here — if he saves Q for the parry window it cancels your activation and you eat the bonus damage anyway.

yourWindow.when: Garen's Q is on cooldown or just whiffed
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Double-Lunge (Q, then the free second dash within its couple-second window) into an auto, then hold W for his empowered attack — he has no silence to stop it.

start.why: The 93.4%-pick, 51.9%-WR start over 156 games — the extra sustain compounds with Duelist's passive healing every time you land a Q poke.

boots.why: 53.5% WR over 114 games; flattens the physical damage from his auto-resets and Judgment spin when he does close the gap.

core.why: Amplifies Duelist healing on-hit and lets you clear wave fast enough to keep threatening Lunge poke uninterrupted.
The proc burst punishes exactly the all-in window when his Q is down, and the post-damage shield eats a chunk of his Judgment tick.
Part of the 63.6%-WR path over 22 games; keeps the damage-and-sustain curve climbing into mid game.

runes.keystoneWhy: A double-Lunge into an auto lands three hits almost instantly, which is exactly what procs Press the Attack — it turns your poke pattern into a burst window before he can react.

summoners.why: The 95.2%-pick, 53.1%-WR combo. Ignite is the direct answer to Perseverance — it shuts off his passive regen mid-trade and turns your all-in windows into kills instead of resets.

playing.title: Bait his Q before all-in
playing.detail: Dash into his auto range once and watch for Decisive Strike. If he throws it, his kit is empty for a beatdown — chain both Lunge dashes immediately.

playing.title: Never open W into his Q
playing.detail: If his Q is up, don't activate Riposte first — the silence from Decisive Strike cancels the parry and you take the bonus damage anyway.

playing.title: Poke to deny his passive
playing.detail: Perseverance only heals him when he hasn't been hit recently. Land a Q every time it's off cooldown just to keep that regen from ticking.

playing.title: Kite with Burst of Speed
playing.detail: E's attack speed window plus the move speed from landed hits and Lunges lets you stay out of his Judgment spin range while still trading.

playing.title: Full-combo from level 3
playing.detail: Once Q, W, and E are all up, your double-Lunge poke plus Duelist healing outpaces the short-range damage from his Judgment.

playing.title: Save R for isolated picks
playing.detail: Blade Waltz deals less on repeated hits to the same target, so use its 110-130s cooldown to burst him down in one clean pass, not to extend an already-losing fight.

playing.title: Respect his execute past level 6
playing.detail: Demacian Justice drops to a 20s cooldown at rank 3 and executes off missing health — don't sit at low HP once he has ultimate up.

brief.patchCaveat: The item paths, rune pages, boots, summoners, and every win-rate or sample number above are pulled directly from measured Fiora-vs-Garen games on the current patch (16.18.1); the trade timing and mechanical reasoning are my own read of the ability kits, not measured data.
